arguments.command:
set -e; bash -n notes/b6_eight_species_blastx_20260915.sbatch; python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
rows=json.loads(Path('/tmp/b6-blastx-eight-inputs.json').read_text())
assert len(rows)==8 and len({r['species'] for r in rows})==8
assert 'Sitalica' not in [r['species'] for r in rows]
print('8 species,',sum(r['records'] for r in rows),'screened EST records')
Path('notes/b6_blastx_eight_inputs_20260915.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
 timeout 20 ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 pronghorn 'set -eu; D=/data/gpfs/assoc/pgl/data/Transgenic/evidence/est_blastx/remaining8_20260915; mkdir "$D"; mkdir "$D/logs"'; scp -q -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 notes/b6_eight_species_blastx_20260915.sbatch pronghorn:/data/gpfs/assoc/pgl/data/Transgenic/evidence/est_blastx/remaining8_20260915/run.sbatch; scp -q -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 notes/b6_blastx_eight_inputs_20260915.json pronghorn:/data/gpfs/assoc/pgl/data/Transgenic/evidence/est_blastx/remaining8_20260915/inputs.json; H=$(sha256sum notes/b6_blastx_eight_inputs_20260915.json | cut -d' ' -f1); printf '%s  inputs.json\n' "$H" | timeout 20 ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 pronghorn 'set -eu; cd /data/gpfs/assoc/pgl/data/Transgenic/evidence/est_blastx/remaining8_20260915; dd of=inputs.sha256 status=none; sha256sum -c inputs.sha256; bash -n run.sbatch; jobs=$(squeue -u "$USER" -h -o "%j"); if printf "%s\n" "$jobs" | grep -Fxq b6_blastx_remaining8; then echo Duplicate >&2; exit 1; fi; mkdir submission.lock; sbatch --parsable --chdir="$PWD" --output="$PWD/logs/%A_%a.out" --error="$PWD/logs/%A_%a.err" "$PWD/run.sbatch" | tee submission.lock/jobid'
